comment: Fleet registry for the Remote Devices rapplication — single source of truth for the tower dashboard's fleet strip AND the satellite towers. Hosts are Tailscale MagicDNS names; vnc:// opens Screen Sharing, http://<host>:<towerPort>/ opens that device's own satellite control tower (satellite/satellite.py), which points back to `main`. Add a device here, then mirror a card in index.html if you want it in the standalone app too.
